profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
My main tech stack is Javascript (ES6+), React, React Hooks, Webpack, Vue, HTML, CSS, Git, and TDD. I have also worked with REST API's, Relational (PostgreSQL) and non-Relational (MongoDB) databases, Node.js, Express.js, and AWS.

Co-developer of OverVue, an open-source cross-platform web application prototyping tool that allows developers to dynamically build and envision Vue applications. (2100+ stars on Github)

Find me on GitHub at github.com/kennyea

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained Codesmith’s public site, bidirectional collaborative IDE platform, and internal tools using React, Redux, and PostgreSQL
• Enhanced platform reliability by increasing test coverage of codebase using React Testing Library and Jest. Conducted unit and integration tests to validate component rendering and controller outputs during authentication. Facilitated continuous development and integration, ensuring robust functionality and optimal user experience
• Mentored junior engineers in core technologies through code reviews, pair programming and workshops, while providing ongoing support for engineering tasks
• Designed and delivered workshops on JavaScript fundamentals to teach aspiring engineers foundational concepts
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · React.js · React Hooks · Test-Driven Development

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Led the development and maintenance of Sketch & Etch's public site, incorporating JavaScript, React, and LiquidJS to elevate the user experience. Achieved a notable 40% increase in website conversions, a 25% reduction in bounce rate, and a 30% improvement in average session duration
• Launched splitter feature on product landing page that drove 20% more traffic to designated landing pages
• Designed the infrastructure for emoji customization features that enabled customers to customize their product. Used React and JavaScript to enhance the e-commerce site to enable this feature to ingest user request on the backend
• Orchestrated cross-functional collaboration among teams to swiftly identify and resolve critical issues, resulting in a 25% improvement in overall site functionality
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · LiquidJS · Shopify Plus · E-Commerce · Front-End Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented Vue.js framework to enable dynamic rendering of single file components via reactive two-way bindings, resulting in improvement in page load time and user experience
• Orchestrated the creation and implementation of a highly scalable Vuex state management library, leveraging modules and direct state mutation. This reduced state management overhead by 40%, optimizing application performance and empowering seamless data sharing across components
• Spearheaded the successful implementation of the Quasar UI framework, enabling rapid development of responsive applications with access to progressive prebuilt Vue-based components. Streamlined user experience with seamless drag-and-drop and resizing capabilities, resulting in increased efficiency and user satisfaction
• Leveraged duplicating shallow copies of components with conditional Vuex state mutations and relational mapping, allowing users to quickly reproduce consistent components while maintaining application hierarchy
• Developed and deployed browser-based Slack OAuth and OS deep link redirect functionality, optimizing webhook configuration and driving an improvement in user satisfaction and an increase in overall productivity

positions.title: Pockets | Budget tracking system
positions.description:
• Refactored to React Hooks to create a single page application & render predictions in graphical UI, resulting in improved magnification, better maintainability of code, streamlined state management, minimal app latency, & dynamic rendering
• Employed Supertest testing suite for server testing to ensure applications integrity & functionality to validate expected outputs & expedite the integration of refactored code & minimize debugging of future implementations
• Dispatched webpack to transpire ES6+ syntax, uglify, & minify application code for future scale & faster load times, decreasing bundle file & network transmission sizes, as well as utilizing hot module reloading for an improved developer experience
• Designed and implemented a PostgreSQL database to store transaction data for individual users, maintaining ACID compliance across the applications data, and ensuring the overall future scalability of the application

positions.title: SUBr | Subscription Management Application
positions.description:
• Configured NoSQL databases to efficiently store structured user streaming data with dynamic schemas, managing embedded documents within each document for quicker referencing
• Utilized React Router to enable a seamless user experience by minimizing server requests within a single page application & establishing static routes for user flow
• Developed a Node.js with Express framework server to efficiently handle HTTP requests & provide seamless data flow of content based on specific user requests & authentication
• Executed React Hooks with functional components for re-usability of stateful logic and easier boilerplate code

positions.title: Customs Broker Assistant Manager
positions.description:
• Supervision of container and rail car disbursement for clients international shipments
• Advised clients on import and export restrictions, while preparing customs documentation and ensuring all shipments met applicable laws to import goods
